verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Stripe Tax provides jurisdiction-level tax reports and itemized exports with line-item tax breakdowns for filing and reconciliation, plus nexus/registration monitoring — covering much of the finance-lead need for filing-ready detail and exports. However, evidence doesn't explicitly show a real-time 'collected vs owed' liability view or confirmed GL-ingestible export formats, and community feedback flags gaps for international completeness and manual filing/remittance steps remaining. Missing for 10: explicit collected-vs-owed accrual dashboard, confirmed GL/accounting-software export compatibility, independent corroboration of report completeness for finance workflows.
